title: fix: prevent vertical text wrapping in chat room header on desktop
body: On desktop viewports (≥640px), `sm:inline` activates text labels (`사진모아보기`, `ON`/`OFF`, `오프라인`) inside the chat header's flex row. The 430px-capped container had no shrink guard on those buttons, so flex shrinking compressed them below their text content width — causing Korean characters to wrap one-per-line vertically. ## Changes - **Mute & photo-gallery buttons** — added `flex-shrink-0` so they are never squeezed by adjacent flex items - **Button label ``s** — added `whitespace-nowrap` to prevent character-level wrapping - **Online/offline status ``** — added `flex-shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` - **Room name ``** — added `min-w-0 truncate` so it truncates gracefully instead of pushing neighbours out ```diff - + - + - className="… inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-60" + className="… inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-shrink-0 disabled:opacity-60" - 사진모아보기 + 사진모아보기 ```
